messages:
matt: Vendor ping: they'd like a single launch day for H100/H200 + MI300 + Gaudi. Problem: Gaudi certs are late. Need partnership take and a pragmatic messaging plan.
vendor-pm: Confirming: H100/H200/MI300 tags ready by Tue. Gaudi drivers in QA, possible 48h slip. Brief: https://vendor.example/launch-brief
sofia: Proposal: internal embargo for all partners, public messaging phased. Announce "joint partnership" on day 0 but mark Gaudi as "limited preview" if it misses.
rahul: From infra: we can gate marketplace SKUs via image-tag states. Suggest two tag states: "launch-ready" and "limited-preview". I'll wire the gating logic.
kevin: We also need fallback routing for requested Gaudi workloads -> MI300-quant or H200-quant. I'll draft routing JSON and a quick test harness.
commops-bot: Uploaded draft press copy to /docs/partners/announce-draft.md. Reminder: avoid firm ship dates per legal.
sofia: Messaging note: use "regional availability at launch" + follow-up timeline post. Keeps comms flexible.
matt: Action list: rahul build tag gates + test; kevin draft fallback routing and test harness; vendor-pm confirm final tags by Tue COB; sofia finalize embargo wording with legal. Reconvene Wed morning.
vendor-pm: Will update here if Gaudi slips. If slip >48h we recommend labeling Gaudi "preview" in marketplace metadata.
kevin: Draft fallback snippet for manifest:
```
"fallbacks": { "gaudi": ["mi300-quant","h200-quant"] }
```
rahul: I'll create a canary job to run smoke tests (chat/summarize/embed x 50 prompts) after tags. ETA 36h post-tags.
sofia: Good. Also prepare an SI early access doc so partners can onboard Gaudi customers outside the marketplace if they need guarantees.
matt: Thanks team. If vendor PM posts hard dates, call it out here and we'll decide final external wording. :thumbsup:
